title: Pond Selection
goal: Choose and purchase the permanent pond vessel.
preferredChoice: Algreen Manhattan 40-inch Balcony Planter & Pond — Brownstone
whyPreferred: Clean rectangular shape fits the Zen design.
Works well with lotus, Buddha and open reflective water.
Allows the permanent pump and filtration to be selected separately.

comparison.name: Algreen Manhattan 40-inch Balcony Planter & Pond
comparison.dimensions: 40 in W × 20 in D × 18 in H
tradeoffs: Pump and permanent filtration are separate purchases

comparison.name: Pennington Aquagarden 50-gallon Pond Kit
strengths: More complete out of the box
tradeoffs: Less aligned with the rectangular architectural look
